RetryConfig now includes max_delay_ms and overflow-safe delay_for_retry; run_job preserves its public signature, retries only transient errors, returns permanent/final errors immediately, and treats max_attempts as including the initial call. Added unit and integration coverage, updated README documentation, ran exact project verification (6 tests passed), rust.workspace checks, cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy with -D warnings, and git diff --check. Diff review found no issues.
